definitions.explanation: A product used to clean the face, including foaming cleansers, gel cleansers, and cream cleansers. A basic step in Japanese skincare routines.

examples.japanese: {洗顔料|せんがんりょう}で{顔|かお}を{洗|あら}う。
examples.english: To wash one's face with facial cleanser.

examples.japanese: {肌|はだ}に{優|やさ}しい{洗顔料|せんがんりょう}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a facial cleanser that is gentle on the skin.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}と{夜|よる}の{二回|にかい}、{洗顔料|せんがんりょう}を{使|つか}って{丁寧|ていねい}に{洗|あら}うのが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to wash carefully with facial cleanser twice a day, morning and night.

notes: Compound of {洗顔|せんがん} (face washing) + {料|りょう} (material/product). Common collocations: {洗顔料|せんがんりょう}を{泡立|あわだ}てる (to lather up facial cleanser), {洗顔料|せんがんりょう}を{選|えら}ぶ (to choose a cleanser). Related skincare vocabulary: {化粧水|けしょうすい} (toner), {乳液|にゅうえき} (moisturizing lotion), {日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め (sunscreen). Also called {洗顔|せんがん}フォーム when referring specifically to foaming types.
